in_marathi.name: Suny
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suny हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit word ‘Surya’ meaning sun, Suny is a name that evokes the bright and radiant energies of the sun. It is a name that represents warmth, vitality, and illumination.
